name: angularly_resolved_scattered_field_power
stage: development contract; official test remains unopened
motivation: Frozen v1 broad receiver sectors concentrate 95.9–98.8 percent of power in 0–10 degree transmitter–receiver differences. Retain v1 in full and resolve all five angular bands, not just a favorable band.
selection_basis: physical angular resolution and a Ridge-only development sensitivity diagnosis; no DAPS/TV angular result was used to choose bands
query: q_(wave,band)=mean over transmitter/receiver pairs in band of |B_wave f|^2
units: normalized field amplitude squared, not calibrated watts or a cross section
contrast: same nondispersive real contrast f at all wavelengths; synthetic Born response
metrics: per-band and per-wavelength absolute log10 error
noise_control: For complex noise with E|epsilon|^2=sigma^2, mean(|y|^2)-sigma^2 is unbiased for each observed band; negative values remain recorded and are not silently clipped for signed errors
reporting: all 15 queries per object; wave=6 is a measured-response control; waves4/8 are unmeasured responses; report near-forward and other bands separately without replacing the full table
uncertainty: Finite DAPS draw intervals are descriptive unless separately calibrated; empirical response mean and response of image mean are separate readouts
comparison_unit: object, not pixel, band or posterior draw
